name: jakarta-ee-tools
author: Moataz Aldawood and his friend Google Gemini ;)
description: Advanced Jakarta Faces (JSF) tools: immediate quote auto-complete & smart EL snippets, Lombok annotation support (@Data, @Getter), incremental bean caching, EL semantic validation, component linking (for <-> id), deep nested Java EL resolution, custom composite component intelligence, and hover documentation. GitHub: https://github.com/Moataz-Aldawood/jakarta-faces-tools

jakartaFacesTools.enableELAutocomplete.title: Enable EL Autocomplete (IntelliSense)
jakartaFacesTools.enableELAutocomplete.description: Enable intelligent auto-complete (IntelliSense) for Java Managed Beans and properties inside Expression Language (EL) #{...} expressions.

jakartaFacesTools.enableIncrementalCache.title: Enable Incremental Java Bean Caching
jakartaFacesTools.enableIncrementalCache.description: Enable real-time Java file watching (**/*.java) and incremental cache updates when Managed Bean files are saved. Disable this in very large repositories or network drives if file watching causes performance issues.

jakartaFacesTools.showRebuildCacheButton.title: Show Rebuild JSF Cache Button
jakartaFacesTools.showRebuildCacheButton.description: Show the 'Rebuild JSF Cache' button in the VS Code Status Bar. Expression Language (EL) Autocomplete caches your Java Managed Beans in memory for fast performance; use this button to force a fresh scan of your project if beans change outside of normal edits.

jakartaFacesTools.rebuildCacheButtonPosi.title: Rebuild JSF Cache Button Position
jakartaFacesTools.rebuildCacheButtonPosi.description: Choose the position ('Right' or 'Left') of the 'Rebuild JSF Cache' button in the VS Code Status Bar when Expression Language (EL) Autocomplete is enabled.

jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.enable.title: Enable EL Coloring and Highlighting
jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.enable.description: Enable highlighting for Expression Language (EL) #{...} expressions.

jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.color.title: Text Color Expression Language (EL)
jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.color.description: Text color in HEX format (#F2994A) for Expression Language (EL) #{...} expressions.Recommended value is(#F2994A) or leave empty to use theme default.

jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.backgro.title: Expression Language (EL) Background Color
jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.backgro.description: Background color in HEX format (#FF0000) or rgba format (rgba(100, 150, 255, 0.15)) for Expression Language (EL) #{...} expressions. Leave empty to use theme default.

jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.border.title: Border Style for Expression Language (EL)
jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.border.description: Border style for Expression Language (EL) #{...} expressions. example: "1px solid rgba(100, 150, 255, 0.3)".

jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.borderR.title: Border Radius for Expression Language (EL)
jakartaFacesTools.ELHighlighting.borderR.description: Border radius for Expression Language (EL) #{...} expressions.

jakartaFacesTools.showInlineBeanScopes.title: Show Inline Bean Scopes (Inlay Hints)
jakartaFacesTools.showInlineBeanScopes.description: Enable inline editor badges (Inlay Hints) around Expression Language (#{...} / ${...}) blocks showing the Java Managed Bean's CDI / Faces scope (e.g. '@ViewScoped : ' or ' : @ViewScoped').

jakartaFacesTools.inlineBeanScopesPositi.title: Inline Bean Scopes Position
jakartaFacesTools.inlineBeanScopesPositi.description: Choose where inline editor scope badges appear relative to Expression Language blocks: 'Pre-EL' displays before the expression ('@ViewScoped : #{bean.property}') and 'Post-EL' displays after the expression ('#{bean.property} : @ViewScoped').

jakartaFacesTools.enableJSFDiagnostics.title: Enable Diagnostics for JSF Tags & Properties
jakartaFacesTools.enableJSFDiagnostics.description: Enable real-time semantic diagnostics (warnings) for unknown or mistyped JSF tags or properties.

jakartaFacesTools.enableELDiagnostics.title: Enable EL Expression Diagnostics
jakartaFacesTools.enableELDiagnostics.description: Enable real-time semantic diagnostics (warnings) for unknown Java Managed Beans and mistyped property names inside #{...} EL expressions.

jakartaFacesTools.enableScopeWarnings.title: Enable Managed Bean Scope Warnings (Experimental)
jakartaFacesTools.enableScopeWarnings.description: [Experimental Feature] Enable best-practice semantic warnings when a @RequestScoped Managed Bean is bound to a stateful UI component (e.g., <p:dataTable>, <h:dataTable>, <ui:repeat>), preventing pagination and sorting state loss across postbacks.

configuration.title: Jakarta Faces Tools: Documentation & Hover Cards

jakartaFacesTools.enableHoverCards.title: Enable Hover Cards & Rich Documentation
jakartaFacesTools.enableHoverCards.description: Enable rich documentation hover cards when hovering over JSF tags, attributes, namespaces, EL, bean scopes and component IDs.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node testElDiagnostics.js && node testIncrementalCache.js && node testLombokSupport.js && node testImmediateAutocomplete.js && node testBeanScopeAwareness.js
